title: 为什么会有四季
subtitle: 地球是斜着转的
character: wearing a green jacket, brown trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration made of embroidered thread on natural linen: shapes filled with neat coloured stitches, visible stitch texture and linen weave, warm folk colours, flat and simple

pages.zh:
同一棵树，
春天开花，夏天绿油油，
秋天变黄，冬天光秃秃。
一年换四次样子。
这是为什么呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands in front of one big tree in a yard, looking up at it, wearing a green jacket, a calm curious face.

pages.zh:
有人以为，
夏天热是因为离太阳近。
其实不是。
地球离太阳的远近，
一年里几乎没怎么变。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one amber sun at the left and one earth at the right on a linen background, joined by a straight line with the same length marked at both ends by two short tick marks. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
真正的原因是：
地球是斜着转的。
它像一个转起来的陀螺，
身子微微歪着，
一直歪向同一个方向。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one earth ball in the middle of a linen background with a straight axis line through it drawn clearly tilted to one side, and a small curved arrow around the ball showing it spinning. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
因为歪着，
所以有半年，北边朝着太阳；
另外半年，
轮到南边朝着太阳。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one amber sun on the left and two earths on the right of a linen background, both with the same tilted axis: the upper earth leaning its top half toward the sun, the lower earth leaning its bottom half toward the sun. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
朝着太阳的那半边，
阳光是直直照下来的，
又亮又暖，
白天也长。
那里就是夏天。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one section of ground on a linen background with three straight sun rays coming down onto it from directly above, the rays drawn thick and close together. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
背着太阳的那半边，
阳光是斜斜擦过去的，
照到的地方就少，
也没那么暖，
白天还很短。那里是冬天。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one section of ground on a linen background with three straight sun rays arriving at a low slanted angle from the side, the rays spread far apart where they meet the ground. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
春天，太阳慢慢变高。
地里的种子发芽了，
树上冒出小小的绿叶，
花一朵一朵开出来。
小鸟也回来了。
pages.scene: One tree covered in fresh green leaves and pink blossom on a linen background, with small flowers on the ground below and one bird on a branch, all embroidered. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
夏天，太阳最高最烈。
树叶长得又大又密，
知了在上面叫个不停。
白天很长，
天黑得很晚。
pages.scene: One tree in full dark green leaf on a linen background, with a bright amber sun high above it and one cicada on the trunk, all embroidered. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
秋天，太阳又变低了。
树叶变黄、变红，
一片一片往下落。
果子熟了，
松鼠忙着收藏过冬的粮食。
pages.scene: One tree with golden and red leaves on a linen background, several leaves falling, and one squirrel holding a nut at the foot of the trunk, all embroidered. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
冬天，太阳最低。
树叶掉光了，
只剩下光秃秃的枝条。
天很冷，
有的地方还会下雪。
pages.scene: One bare tree with no leaves on a linen background, thin snow on its branches and on the ground, a pale low sun near the horizon, all embroidered. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
地球绕着太阳走一圈，
刚好是一年。
走到不同的位置，
我们这里就换一个季节：
春、夏、秋、冬，一年一次。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one amber sun in the middle of a linen background with one large circle around it, and four small earths spaced evenly on that circle, each with the same tilted axis. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我在树下捡了一片黄叶子，
夹进我的本子里。
等明年春天，
这棵树又会开花。
我要在同一个地方再看一次。
pages.scene: The little boy crouches under the bare tree holding one yellow leaf up to look at it, a notebook open on the ground beside him.
